name: Utility Pouch
description: A small pouch of stiff webbing. It goes inside something bigger.

name: Canvas Satchel
description: A canvas satchel on a long strap. It rides at the hip and opens one-handed.

name: Steel Toolbox
description: A steel toolbox with a folding handle. Awkward to carry and worth it.

name: Chest Rig
description: A chest rig of stitched pouches. Everything in it is a hand's reach away.

name: Hiking Pack
description: A proper hiking pack. It carries a great deal and it is on your back, not your front.

name: School Bag
description: A child's school bag, straps knotted where they broke.

name: Frame Pack
description: An external-frame pack. Ugly, rigid, and it takes what nothing else will.

name: Medic Pouch
description: A medic's belt pouch, marked with a faded cross. Dressings, where a hand can find them.

name: Canvas Bandolier
description: A canvas bandolier across the chest. Long thin things ride in it.

name: Canvas Duffel
description: A long canvas duffel with a shoulder strap. It swallows a great deal and hangs badly while it does.
